name: Tree-Support-Saturated Classes Need Not Be Partial Cubes
scope: Finite displayed Boolean classes, compared through their one-inclusion graphs.
statement: Not every member of tree-support-saturated classes is a partial cube.
proof: The only tree supports of $H'$ have size at most one. Every missing concept raises its Littlestone dimension from one to two, creating a new support of size at least two; hence $H'$ is tree-support-saturated, while its one-inclusion graph is disconnected.
